title: Nuclear & Related Techniques for Climate Action in Food and Agriculture
shortDescription: Flagship documentary video produced to showcase the Joint FAO/IAEA Centre’s nuclear science innovations for climate action at the COP28 UAE Pavilion and installed permanently at the IAEA Seibersdorf visitor center.
mandateChallenge: Translate highly technical nuclear isotopic techniques - plant mutation breeding, soil-water management, and sterile insect technique - into an urgent, human-centered cinematic narrative for heads of state and climate negotiators at COP28.
executionCraft: Wrote, directed on location in greenhouse & laboratory facilities, edited in Premiere Pro, and animated custom kinetic data callouts and atomic orbital overlays in After Effects with full broadcast sound mastering.
impactMetric: Screened at COP28 UAE Pavilion · +35% Multi-Channel Impressions
